actions.action: Isolate the plant away from other plants
Dab the mealybug with a cotton swab dipped in 70% rubbing alcohol and wipe it off
Inspect the whole plant (leaf undersides, joints, stem tip, soil surface, pot rim) and swab any bugs found
Repeat the inspection every 3-4 days for 4 weeks, keeping the plant isolated until two clean checks

reason: The answer identifies the mealybug as the main problem and recommends dabbing it with alcohol and inspecting thoroughly, which matches the fix that worked; none of its advice is harmful.
